basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old student living in São Paulo, Brazil, currently studying law. I have a growing interest in neurodiversity and often explore subreddits related to mental health. During my free time, I enjoy reading about different cultures and spending time with my cat, Luna. I usually browse Reddit during late evenings after university classes and on weekends. I'm single and enjoy connecting with people online who share similar interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of legal studies due to my current education. My interest in neurodiversity comes from personal experiences and self-directed learning through books and online resources.
